next_steps: MEASUREMENT REQUEST. (1) Pull the official registry JSONs (fetched 2026-11-16, raw.githubusercontent.com/solv-finance/solv-protocol-defillama/refs/heads/main/): solv-funds.json bsc section (tokenSupply + lpV3/aaves books), solv-strategies.json bsc (solvbtc + strategies keys), solv-fees-v2.json bsc (marketAddress/poolId entries, e.g. xSolvBTC-BSC-SolvBTC market 0xaE050694c137aD777611286C316E5FDda58242F3), solv-fees.json bsc (poolFees/receivedPureRevenue). Pin every address you use with a getter eth_call before building on it (registry files are docs, not proof). (2) On a SolvToken (one of the three symbol-verified ones above) read the queue access control: does it have maturity/claim (addressMaturity/lockedBy/claim) and is settlement (settleDeposit/settleRedeem/setNav) MANAGER-gated? Read the verified source on bscscan (explorer tool does not cover bsc; use curl to api.bscscan or the verified-source page) for onlyMANAGER/onlyRole on settle entries and for any caller reward (transfer to msg.sender, fee share, discount captured). (3) If any entry is open AND paid: measure 30-d cadence of the paid call via eth_getLogs on the SolvToken/market emitters (bsc getLogs costs CU, ranges <=5000 blocks, same-run positive control required) x median net payout from the winner's receipts (gasUsed x gasPrice in BNB, priced). (4) Gate: if all settlement is role-gated and claims are user-paid, dead_end at check 1 (open to anyone?) - do not build. Note bsc USDC has 18 decimals if USDC legs appear.
